notes.title: Plushes: Cute, but Deadly
notes.content:
[p]Meet [b]PLUSHES[/b] — an action-adventure game with metroidvania elements, where cuteness has gone too far.[/p][p][/p][p]You are a young Plush Fighter trying to survive in an anomalous version of Moscow overrun by deranged plush creatures. These soft, round enemies may look adorable — but don’t be fooled. They scream, roll, spit, and explode, plunging the city into total chaos.[/p][p][/p][p]The announcement teaser is now available on the game's Steam page and on our WATT Studio social media channels.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="JQ4VbzwDCMU;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p][b]Add PLUSHES to your Steam wishlist to try to survive this madness in a story balancing on the edge of trash and drama![/b][/p][p]
[/p]
